title: Domistika Closed-Loop Visual Critic

passes.name: pass-1-shell
passes.intent: Create an orange kaleidoscopic outer gear/membrane on a fresh 1200x1200 canvas.
passes.observedDecision: The outer shell had strong motion and an intentionally open center, so the next pass was tightened instead of reusing the older dense vortex.

passes.name: pass-2-vortex
passes.intent: Add a compact dark-blue rotational field inside the orange shell.
passes.observedDecision: The vortex remained contained and readable, leaving a visible interface gap between rotational core and outer membrane.

passes.name: pass-3-interface-bubbles
passes.intent: Add twelve thin purple bubble bearings at the core/shell interface.
passes.observedDecision: The interface became explicit and the center remained visually under-weighted, motivating a small unsymmetrized final core.

passes.name: pass-4-final-core-archive
passes.intent: Add a small teal center core, archive to local Domistika Gallery, and return to Studio.
